instruction: From now on, whenever you put a pen in my pen case, turn the pen so that it lines up with the long side of the case before you lower it. Please put the blue pen in the green pen case now.

attempts.code:
candidates = grasp_candidates("blue_pen")
candidate = candidates[0]  # Use the first grasp candidate
grasp(candidate)

spots = free_spots("green_case", "blue_pen")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
target_x, target_y = spot["x"], spot["y"]
target_yaw = spot["object_long_axis_yaw"]  # Align pen with case's long axis

carry_to(target_x, target_y, height=0.18, yaw=target_yaw)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("blue_pen", "green_case")
